title: Action
description: One action the agent decides. Written to the shared database by HappyRobot workflows; the simulator applies its effects on the world; the dashboard renders the action log. Actions with real_interaction produce an actual call, email, or SMS. evidence and reasoning are mandatory: they are the transparency the judges score.

actor.description: Entity id that executes the action. The verb must be in that entity's capabilities and the target zones inside its jurisdiction. The value system is a valid actor for system verbs (register_entity, update_entity).

verb.description: The action verb. World verbs are executed by entities: send_es_alert, order_evacuation, close_road, rescue, pump_water, shelter, supplies, wellness_check, request_ume, activate_emergency_level, open_shelter. System verbs are executed by the agent itself: register_entity (create a discovered entity from a signal), update_entity (revise entity attributes from runtime evidence: units lost, status unreachable, trust downgraded).

target_zones.description: Zone ids the action applies to. Must be inside the actor's jurisdiction.

params.description: Verb-specific parameters. For send_es_alert: the message text. For rescue: number of units. For register_entity: the full new entity object.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Actions whose actor has activation cost high enter pending_approval and wait for a human on the dashboard, with a timeout that auto-escalates. failed records real-world execution errors (call not answered); the agent must then escalate via escalation_to.

evidence.description: Signal ids that justify this action. Mandatory and never empty: every decision must be traceable to observed signals.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences of agent reasoning for this action, written for a human supervisor (Gauge trend rising plus 4 corroborating reports upstream). Shown verbatim on the dashboard.

real_interaction.description: The real-world contact this action produced, if any. Filled after execution as proof of real interaction (a track requirement).
